steps.title: Smoke test on Fun-Audio-Chat: LoRA + ZeRO-3 and QLoRA

steps.note: Main line moved to MiniCPM-o, which already runs in full duplex. Its duplex sequence is one unit per second of audio, with <|listen|> / <|speak|>, <|chunk_eos|> and <|turn_eos|>; the language model (Qwen3-8B) can take LoRA. Samples are stored model-neutral, so the data serves either model.

steps.note: 17,397 labeled (83 dropped: answer outside the label set). 14,168 suit voice: 11,312 lookup, 1,515 search, 1,341 action. Held out six whole domains (health, food, calendar, weather, real_estate, jobs): 1,662 tools, 276 of them action; 12,506 tools left for training.
steps.title: Tool weight labels (lookup, search, action)

steps.note: Done: all 154 batches written and checked (15,383 of 15,400 kept), then two fix passes after whole-dataset reviews. First pass: 83 dropped, 3,420 rewritten, all passed. Second pass: 227 dropped (secrets said aloud, non-English text, contradictory asks, chained calls) and 208 repeated chat topics rewritten, all passed. Final set: 15,073 samples (train 13,684, dev 697, test 692); call 34.6%, handoff 30.1%, ask 14.7%, chat 10.3%, split 10.3%; 2,084 filler, 803 self-correction.
steps.title: Requests and targets (fast tools in the frontend, the rest handed off)

steps.note: Many voices; silence of 0.5 to 2 s inside about 30% of requests, so the model learns to keep listening. Starts only after your go-ahead.
steps.title: TTS, with pauses at phrase boundaries

steps.note: Feasibility test done. The duplex decoder bans "\n" (6,965 banned tokens), so chat-mode tool calls can never come out in duplex. Format: one unit per second, calls on one line as <tool_call>{...}</tool_call> before speech, results as text units. 200 samples spoken with Kokoro, bf16 LoRA on 2 cards for 20 minutes. On 60 held-out samples through the real duplex loop: target right 52/60 greedy and 54/60 sampling vs 20/60 untrained (which never calls a tool); acknowledgment on every handoff; no call text reaches TTS. Result fed back as a text unit (34 held-out samples): tells the user with a value from the result in 30/34 (untrained 15/34), 33/34 tell the user at all, 1 hands off again.
steps.title: MiniCPM-o duplex format, training setup and smoke test

steps.note: Claude reviewed all 280 first: target right 97.5% (gate 95%), fully correct 89.6% (gate 90%, one short). You decided the four problem groups: requests that read out API codes are unnatural except player-type IDs; ISO dates become spoken dates at TTS; first-round ask rewrites are dropped across the whole set; the 6 samples with leaked details are dropped. Per-sample check of Claude's 39 flagged and spot-checked samples on the Review Desk: 0 of 39 so far.
steps.title: Your review of the data
Untrained MiniCPM-o baseline
steps.note: Done in text chat mode (full duplex has no tool-call path; TTS not run yet): official MiniCPM-o 4.5 code, fast tools + spawn_thinking, 692 test samples. Target accuracy 59.2%: call 61.2%, handoff 84.5%, ask 13.8%, split 49.3%, chat 62.4%. It over-hands-off (75 call and 25 chat items sent to the backend), almost never asks, and says nothing when it hands off (0 of 198). Reporting a backend result already works: 31/31 right after the handoff, 30/31 after an unrelated exchange. To rerun on speech after TTS.
Learning curve on 25%, 50% and 100% of the data to see whether more data would help.
